title: A Protocol for the Contact
author: Marguerite Reyes
blurb: Sebastian Marchetti, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
